findings.violated_invariant: Fixture schema paragraph: 'Reject malformed/empty SHA/IDs/brackets, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers. Errors are stable owner-coded refusals' — the malformed-input half has zero assertion-bearing tests
findings.scenario: A regression in require_sha (accepts uppercase/non-40-hex), require_id (accepts empty basin/segment), require_origin (accepts credentials/query/fragment), require_ordered_bracket (accepts start>end or non-decimal), or require_absolute_path (accepts relative paths) merges green: no test asserts C4_SHA_INVALID, C4_ORIGIN_INVALID, C4_BASIN_INVALID, C4_SEGMENT_INVALID, C4_BRACKET_INVALID, C4_PATH_INVALID, or C4_TOO_LARGE (>256 KiB record). Only valid-input positives and one valid-but-mismatched SHA are exercised; the JSON duplicate/nonfinite/complex half IS tested (test_publish_refuses_duplicate_json_and_nonfinite_numbers, test_complex_json_is_refused).
